issue.title: Forward log_events_on_startup to the GKE and EKS deferrable pod triggers
issue.body:
### Description

#75013 adds `log_events_on_startup` to `KubernetesPodOperator` and `KubernetesPodTrigger` so users on large clusters can switch off the startup event watcher, which makes the API server read every event in the namespace on each poll.

The GKE and EKS operators inherit the synchronous path, so the parameter works there in sync mode. In deferrable mode it is lost:

- `GKEStartPodOperator.invoke_defer_method` (`providers/google/src/airflow/providers/google/cloud/operators/kubernetes_engine.py`) builds `GKEStartPodTrigger` with an explicit kwarg list that does not include the flag, and `GKEStartPodTrigger.serialize()` re-lists its fields without it.
- `EksPodOperator.invoke_defer_method` (`providers/amazon/src/airflow/providers/amazon/aws/operators/eks.py`) builds `EksPodTrigger` the same way, and `EksPodTrigger.__init__` has a fixed signature with no `**kwargs`.

`KubernetesPodTrigger.serialize()` therefore emits the key only when the flag is `False`, so neither subclass breaks, but `GKEStartPodOperator(deferrable=True, log_events_on_startup=False)` and the EKS equivalent still watch events in the triggerer. The provider docs (`providers/cncf/kubernetes/docs/operators.rst`, "Pod events in the task log") state this limitation.

### Work needed

1. Forward `log_events_on_startup` from both operators to their triggers.
2. Accept and serialize it in `EksPodTrigger` and include it in `GKEStartPodTrigger.serialize()` (only when `False`, matching the base trigger).
3. Raise the `apache-airflow-providers-cncf-kubernetes` minimum version in the google and amazon providers to the release that ships the parameter; the trigger `__init__` of older cncf versions rejects the kwarg.
4. Remove the limitation sentence from the cncf docs.

### Acceptance criteria

- `GKEStartPodOperator(deferrable=True, log_events_on_startup=False)` and `EksPodOperator(deferrable=True, log_events_on_startup=False)` create no event watch in the triggerer (unit test on each trigger's `_wait_for_pod_start`).
- Default serialization of both triggers stays unchanged.

### Related

- #75013
- #75016 (the cncf change that introduces the parameter)

---
Drafted-by: Claude Code (Fable 5.1) (no human review before posting)
